coder: second coder: automated-assisted (LLM agent reading git objects with git show/grep at four snapshots), NOT a human; coded before opening the R6 control table (res_t1_controls.json, t1_controls.py); the R6 notes.md summary had been read

controls.pred: submit/suggest requires signed-in user (policy create?/propose? = user; v2 authenticated mutation)
suggest revision: comment required, length >= 10
acting organisation in user's organisations (belongs_to_action_organization? / validate_user_acting_as_org)
accept/reject other's evidence item requires role >= editor
accept revision requires role >= editor (v2: except submitter of a still-submitted subject)
submitter may not accept own evidence item (S1: admins exempt, from 2016-02-24; full from 2016-07-20)
revisor may not accept own revision (S1: admins exempt; v2: bypassed when acceptor is submitter of still-submitted subject)
assertion accept: editor and not submitter
valid (unexpired) COI statement to moderate evidence items
valid COI to accept/reject assertions
valid COI to accept/reject revisions
reject revision: comment required, length >= 10
reject/revert evidence item or assertion: comment required
approve assertion: can_approve_for_org and valid COI
accept revision refused if field's current value != revision's base value (ChangeApplicationConflictError), unless editor passes force
approve assertion refused if assertion not accepted or flagged
flagging requires signed-in user (+ acting org)
flag: comment required, length >= 10
scheduled job FlagDuplicateAlleleRegistryIds raises flags as bot
resolve flag: flagger, or editor with valid COI
resolve flag: comment required, length >= 10
on acceptance, pending revisions of same subject+field set superseded (v1 job 2015-04..2016-02; v2 action)
submitting an evidence item from a source suggestion sets the suggestion to curated (v1 2016-10 onward)
rejected evidence item set back to submitted when a revision is suggested or accepted (v1 2016-01)
active approvals set requires_review on flag, revision acceptance, EI/assertion moderation
editor changing source-suggestion status needs valid COI
submitter may reject (withdraw) own evidence item

absences.note: no code orders or restricts which pending item an editor may decide (all snapshots)
no owner/assignee/due-date field or rule on evidence items or revisions (all snapshots)
no job or scheduled task writes evidence-item status (all snapshots)
no guard refusing EI acceptance while a revision is pending (all snapshots)
